sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: PC block is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A 4x4 grid computer case that can be searched to find PC components.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: In addition to the items from the inside, Secure Flash drives can occasionally be found plugged into PC blocks.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
Red PC cases can usually not be looted, but there are 2 exceptions:
- The one located in dorm room 213 of the two-story dorms building on Customs.
- The one located in dorm room 212 of the three-story dorms building on Customs.
